context: Decision: either (a) add a lightweight macOS (and windows) framing smoke to the PR gate so darwin/windows binaries are validated pre-merge, or (b) keep nightly-only but add a pre-merge checksum-consistency gate (cheap, ubuntu-runnable) as a proxy and document the nightly-only behavioral coverage. Pick based on runner-minute cost vs. how often binaries change.
description: The framing binary guard tests/unit/core/tpch/test_tpch_dbgen_framing_binaries.py execute each bundled dbgen and assert no trailing '|'. But .github/workflows/pr.yml is ubuntu-latest only, so on the develop PR gate every non-linux binary is foreign-arch and skipped per-binary -- the darwin-arm64 binary shipped in PR #1256 is never behaviorally executed pre-merge. Full os matrix (macos-latest, windows-latest) runs only in nightly.yml (post-merge). So a green PR gate does not prove darwin/windows binaries frame correctly; that proof currently comes from local runs + the next nightly. Surfaced during PR #1256 review.

preserves.behavior: Existing ubuntu PR-gate jobs and their required-check contract are unchanged
No change to the bundled binaries themselves
The nightly full-matrix framing coverage remains intact

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/unit/core/tpch/test_tpch_dbgen_framing_binaries.py -m 'unit or slow' -q
verifications.description: Framing guard tests still pass on the host runner

verifications.command: uv run -- python -c "import yaml,glob; [yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('.github/workflows/*.yml')]"
verifications.description: Workflow YAML is valid after edit

work_units.evidence: rg confirms pr.yml has no binary-framing job; nightly.yml alone runs the slow guard across ubuntu/macos/windows
work_units.summary: Revalidate that pr.yml is ubuntu-only and the darwin-arm64 framing guard is skipped pre-merge on current develop

work_units.evidence: uv run -- python YAML contract assertion: tpch-binary-framing covers macos-latest and windows-latest without changing ci-required-result
work_units.summary: Decide (a) add macOS/windows pre-merge framing smoke vs (b) pre-merge checksum-consistency proxy + documented nightly coverage

work_units.evidence: Added .github/workflows/pr.yml tpch-binary-framing matrix for macos-latest and windows-latest with the existing runtime framing guard
pytest framing guard, all-workflow YAML parse, and deliberate trailing-delimiter mutation rejection all passed
work_units.summary: Verify pre-merge coverage now catches a deliberately mis-framed/mismatched binary
